title: AutoBench Task
description: Specification for a single AutoBench task. Every task file under tasks/<category>/ must validate against this schema.

difficulty.description: Author's difficulty estimate. Refined after first evaluation runs.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the agent is expected to accomplish.

user_message.description: The initial message the simulated user (or the caller) sends to the agent.

system_prompt.description: System prompt the agent runs under. Should include any policy the agent must follow.

available_tools.description: Tool names the agent has access to. Definitions live in a shared tools/ registry.

initial_state.description: Snapshot of the mock backend state at task start (e.g. CRM records, calendar entries, ticket queue).

expected_final_state.description: State the backend should be in when the task ends. Compared against actual state at completion.

required_tool_calls.description: Tool calls that MUST occur for the task to be considered correctly executed. Order-sensitive only when 'order_sensitive' is true.

args_contain.description: Key/value pairs that the tool call arguments must contain (subset match).

acceptable_responses.description: Semantic criteria or regex the agent's final message must satisfy. Evaluated by an LLM judge with confidence threshold.

reliability.description: Reliability-focused expectations that go beyond binary task success.

forbidden_claims.description: Claims the agent must NOT make (e.g. inventing a company detail, promising a refund not permitted by policy).

required_disclosures.description: Statements the agent MUST include (e.g. 'confirm before booking').

policy_rules.description: Domain rules the agent must follow. Failure to follow counts as a policy violation, not a task failure.

max_tool_calls.description: Trials exceeding this are terminated and counted as failures.

expected_cost_range_usd.description: Expected [min, max] USD cost for a well-behaved agent. Used to flag outliers, not to fail runs.

failure_injection.description: If present, the harness injects a controlled failure to test recovery.

domain_source.description: One of: 'synthetic', 'real-anonymised', 'literature-derived'. Real-anonymised tasks must be scrubbed of any client-identifying data.
